case_name: Basic single drawdown – 12 equal monthly repayments, no charges
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part I – basic equation; Commission guidelines illustrative example (constructed from formula)

computation.iteration_summary: solving by Newton–Raphson: X₀=0.05 → LHS=9,989.2 → X₁=0.0502 → LHS=10,000.0
computation.rounding: expressed as 5.0% (one decimal per Annex I)

assumptions_applied: immediate full drawdown at t=0
repayments at equal monthly intervals, 1/12 year each
year = 365 days (or 12 equal months of 30.41666 days per Annex III remark (c))
no charges other than interest
credit agreement remains valid for full term
weakest_point: repayment amount is rounded to 2 decimals; APRC is iterative and sensitive to rounding convention

case_name: Charges paid at conclusion – arrangement fee
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part I; Part II point (g)(ii) – non-interest charge as single sum paid at conclusion

inputs.charges: arrangement fee of 500 EUR paid at conclusion (t=0)

computation.rounding: expressed as 8.2% (one decimal, rounding up per Annex I)

assumptions_applied: immediate full drawdown at t=0
fee paid at conclusion (t=0) per Part II point (g)(ii)
repayments at equal monthly intervals, 1/12 year each
year = 365 days (or 12 equal months)
credit agreement remains valid for full term
weakest_point: fee timing assumption is explicit in Part II (g)(ii) – if fee were spread, APRC would differ

case_name: Irregular intervals – first repayment after 2 months
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part I – general equation with fractional intervals

inputs.repayment_schedule: payment 1 at s₁ = 2/12 year (2 months), payments 2–12 at s_l = (l+1)/12 year
inputs.nominal_rate: 5% p.a. (used to construct repayments with 2-month deferral)

computation.iteration_summary: with D adjusted so PV=10,000 at X=0.05 (D≈876.22); solving for X with D=876.22: X₀=0.05 → RHS=9,998.9 → X=0.0501 (5.01%)

assumptions_applied: immediate full drawdown at t=0
intervals expressed as fractions of a year using 30.41666-day months per Annex III remark (c)
repayment amounts equalized to preserve PV at nominal rate
credit agreement remains valid for full term
weakest_point: irregular intervals require day-count convention (365/366 per year, counting backwards per Annex III remark (c)) – this example uses monthly fractions

annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part II point (d) – overdraft, duration unknown → 3 months

inputs.drawdown_schedule: deemed drawn in full at t=0
inputs.repayment_schedule: single repayment of 1,050 EUR at 3 months

assumptions_applied: overdraft facility, duration not known → deemed duration 3 months per Part II point (d)
amount deemed drawn in full and for whole duration
single repayment at end of 3 months
year = 365 days (or 12 equal months)
weakest_point: if duration were known, APRC would be calculated over actual duration; 3‑month assumption is a default

case_name: Open‑end credit – 1‑year assumption, equal monthly repayments
annex_basis: Directive 2008/48/EC Annex I Part II point (e) – open‑end credit (non‑overdraft), 1‑year term

inputs.repayment_schedule: 12 equal monthly repayments of 88.85 EUR (capital + interest)

assumptions_applied: open‑end credit agreement (non‑overdraft) per Part II point (e)
credit provided for 1 year from initial drawdown
final payment clears balance of capital, interest and charges
capital repaid in equal monthly instalments, first payment 1 month after drawdown
year = 365 days (or 12 equal months)
weakest_point: open‑end assumption applies only when actual duration is not fixed; if agreement specifies a different term, that term prevails
